# Orbit 2 — repository instructions for GitHub Copilot

Before substantive work on any repository task, read [AGENTS.md](../AGENTS.md) and follow the [mandatory initialization protocol](../docs/agents/contributor-instructions.md#mandatory-initialization). This applies to every Orbit 2 request, including read-only questions, short follow-ups, research, planning, review, implementation and delegated work. Follow the [repository-first response policy](../docs/agents/contributor-instructions.md#repository-first-response-policy).

The [canonical contributor instructions](../docs/agents/contributor-instructions.md) govern task routing, verification and handoffs. Do not bulk-load unrelated documentation or duplicate policy here.
